description: Each case is a broken file. Give the prompt to an agent that has the skill installed, then check the expectations. Automated check: after the fix, `node scripts/audit-images.mjs <fixed file>` must report 0 errors.

evals.name: stretched-flex
evals.prompt: The images on this page look squished on mobile and stretched in the thumbnails. Fix them. File: evals/cases/01-stretched-flex.html
evals.expected_output: All four images keep their aspect ratio at every width.
expectations: Adds height: auto to the .post img rule (or a global img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; } reset)
Adds object-fit: cover (or contain) to .thumb and explains that cover crops the portrait photo
Fixes the flex row image: flex-shrink: 0, or a wrapper, and object-fit for the square box
Fixes the inline style on the team image (object-fit: cover, or height: auto instead of 320px)
Does not remove the width/height attributes

evals.name: lazy-hero
evals.prompt: Lighthouse says our LCP is slow and images are too big. Fix the image markup. File: evals/cases/02-lazy-hero.html
evals.expected_output: One LCP image with high priority and correct dimensions; correct sizes; no conflicting preload.
expectations: Removes loading="lazy" from the hero and adds fetchpriority="high"
Adds width and height to the hero (and asks for or reads the real dimensions instead of guessing)
Replaces data-src / lazyload on the banner with a real src (and no JavaScript lazy loading)
Removes fetchpriority="high" from the four product cards
Adds a sizes attribute to every srcset with w descriptors, based on the grid layout (or asks for the layout)
Resolves the preload/lazy conflict for promo.jpg (removes the preload, or removes lazy if the image is above the fold)
Adds alt and dimensions to the footer logo
Product cards below the fold get loading="lazy"

evals.name: nextjs-cards
evals.prompt: Our Next.js 15 product page has a slow LCP and the product cards look stretched. Fix it. File: evals/cases/03-nextjs-cards.tsx
evals.expected_output: Hero has priority; cards have sizes, objectFit cover and no priority (or only the first); avatar has dimensions and object-cover.
expectations: Adds priority to the ProductHero image (Next.js 15), and mentions loading="eager" + fetchPriority="high" for Next.js 16+
Removes priority from the cards in the map (or makes it conditional on the first item)
Adds sizes to the fill images that matches grid-cols-2 / lg:grid-cols-4
Adds objectFit cover (style or className object-cover) to the fill images
Adds width and height (48x48 or similar) to the Avatar and object-cover, and fixes w-12 h-16 to a square or explains the crop
Checks the next.config remotePatterns for remote product images (or mentions it)

evals.name: vue-gallery
evals.prompt: This Vue gallery (Vite SPA) has a slow hero and distorted photos. Fix it. File: evals/cases/04-vue-gallery.vue
evals.expected_output: Hero is a real with dimensions and fetchpriority high, preloaded in index.html; gallery has sizes and object-cover; GIF replaced.
expectations: Replaces v-lazy on the hero with :src, adds width/height and fetchpriority="high"
Recommends a preload in index.html because the app is a client-rendered SPA
Adds sizes for the 1 / 3 column grid (for example (min-width: 768px) 33vw, 100vw, adjusted for gaps)
Adds object-cover to the w-full h-64 gallery images
Suggests replacing the GIF with a <video autoplay muted loop playsinline>

evals.name: background-hero
evals.prompt: Our home page hero loads late and we download two promo images. Fix it. File: evals/cases/05-background-hero.html
evals.expected_output: Hero is an with object-fit cover (or a preloaded, responsive background); promo uses ; feature uses art direction.
expectations: Converts the CSS background hero to an with object-fit: cover and fetchpriority="high" (or adds a matching preload and image-set)
Uses responsive files instead of a single 4000px image
Replaces the two display:none promo images with one <picture> and <source media>
Fixes the feature image: separate <source media> for the tall and wide crops, with width/height on each
Explains why (late discovery, both files download, aspect ratio changes)

evals.name: angular-hero
evals.prompt: Angular shows errors and warnings about our images. Fix the component. File: evals/cases/06-angular-hero.component.ts
evals.expected_output: priority without loading; fill with sizes and object-fit; logo with width/height.
expectations: Removes loading="lazy" from the priority hero image
Adds sizes and object-fit: cover to the fill card image
Adds width and height to the logo (with the intrinsic size), or uses fill with a sized parent
Mentions configuring an image loader (CDN or custom) for automatic srcset

evals.name: astro-page
evals.prompt: Make the images on this Astro 5 page fast and correct. File: evals/cases/07-astro-page.astro
evals.expected_output: Hero has priority (5.10+) or eager + high; public image has dimensions or is imported; widths has sizes.
expectations: Checks the Astro version and uses priority (5.10+) or loading="eager" fetchpriority="high" on the hero
Fixes /team.jpg: imports it from src/ or adds width and height
Adds sizes to the image with widths, or uses the layout prop

evals.name: no-overreach
evals.prompt: Add a new product card component to examples/card-grid.html, matching the existing cards.
evals.expected_output: A new card that follows the same pattern, without changing the existing correct images.
expectations: The new card image has width, height, srcset, sizes matching the grid, loading="lazy" and decoding="async"
Does not add fetchpriority="high" to the new card
Does not change the existing cards

evals.name: social-meta
evals.prompt: When we share this page on Facebook, LinkedIn and WhatsApp there is no image, and on X there is no card. Fix the meta tags. The site is https://acme.com. File: evals/cases/08-social-meta.html
evals.expected_output: Complete og:* and twitter:* tags with an absolute 1200x630 JPG/PNG image.
expectations: Changes og:title / og:description to use property= instead of name=
Replaces the relative SVG og:image with an absolute https://acme.com/... JPG or PNG at 1200x630
Explains that SVG is not supported for link previews and proposes creating a 1200x630 image (for example with scripts/make-social-images.mjs)
Adds og:image:width, og:image:height and og:image:alt
Adds twitter:card summary_large_image and removes or fixes the localhost twitter:image
Adds og:url and og:type
Mentions refreshing the cache (Facebook Sharing Debugger, LinkedIn Post Inspector) after deploying

evals.name: social-image-sizes
evals.prompt: I have one product photo (4000x3000). Make the share images for Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, X and Pinterest, and give me the tags. Site: https://acme.com, folder /social.
evals.expected_output: 1200x630 og image under 300 KB, optional 1200x600 X image, 1000x1500 Pinterest image, and the matching tags.
expectations: Creates (or gives the exact command for) a 1200x630 JPG for og:image, compressed under about 300 KB
Explains that one 1200x630 image covers Facebook, LinkedIn and WhatsApp
Optionally creates a 1200x600 image for twitter:image, with twitter:card summary_large_image
Creates a 1000x1500 (2:3) image for Pinterest and explains data-pin-media
Prints tags with absolute https://acme.com/social/... URLs and the real width/height
Warns that cover cropping may cut off parts of the photo and suggests checking the crops

evals.name: alt-text-policy
evals.prompt: Our policy is that every image must have its alt filled. Fix this product page. File: evals/cases/09-alt-text.html
evals.expected_output: Every image has a filled, specific alt; the decorative divider has a filled alt plus aria-hidden; og:image:alt and twitter:image:alt are added.
expectations: Adds a specific alt to the image without alt (for example 'Acme Trail 2, red'), using the page context
Replaces alt="", alt="image" and alt="IMG_2041.jpg" with specific descriptions that differ from each other (sole view, on foot, ...)
Removes the 'Image of' prefix
Gives the decorative divider a filled alt and aria-hidden="true"
Gives the cart icon link image a functional alt such as 'Go to cart' (and does NOT add aria-hidden, because it is the only content of the link)
Adds og:image:alt and twitter:image:alt
Does not change the two correct images
Lists alt texts that are guesses as 'alt needs review'
After the fix, node scripts/audit-images.mjs evals/cases/09-alt-text.html reports 0 errors and 0 alt warnings
